delivered.production code: none needed — the Codex window/estimate logic is the existing shared business; this ticket delivers the pi-host wiring evidence plus one coverage gap it found

delivered.new test: tests/model-cost/codex-quota.test.ts — 'a position whose report carries no usable reading or length is left out rather than completed'

criteria.criterion: AC1 / P30 — independent reports: position swap, single window, missing reading, failure, reset unknown/expired/invalid/valid; a missing reading is never zero and never re-times the old reading
criteria.evidence: tests/model-cost/codex-quota.test.ts (16 tests) — position swap, single-window update keeping the other window's value AND obtainedAt, both failure classes, failed attempt earning no TTL, join of an in-flight query, all four reset states with the instant never rewritten; plus the new missing-reading/-length case. Validated by fault injection: `numberOf(window.usedPercent) ?? 0` in windowsOf made the new case fail with usedPercent 0 and a moved obtainedAt; restored → 16 pass / 0 fail. Real host: phase-5 checks 1–5, 8, 12.

criteria.criterion: AC2 / P31 — hand-computed numbers: 50-point threshold, both windows growing, saturation, unpaired update, baseline, refinement; merged old/new windows are never paired into a sample
criteria.evidence: tests/model-cost/codex-estimate.test.ts — hand-written literals: 50/5 → ratio 10.0, below-threshold/saturation keeping the stored ratio, a one-window report pairing nothing, rollover rebaselining, the five-hour age bound, baseline published at once with ratio unknown, the one-minute refinement throttle, merge by capture instant (newer adopted / older superseded / equal left to the writer), and a restart sampling from the stored baseline. Real host: phase-5 checks 9, 10, 14.

criteria.criterion: AC3 — baseline saved at once, refinement throttled, newer document merged, restored by a new process; a consumption-period change does not clear the estimate
criteria.evidence: the estimate suite's document half (real codex-usage-estimate.json bytes) + tests/model-cost/period-switch.test.ts (the independent estimate survives a reset). Real host: checks 6 (baseline written before any Turn), 9/11 (unpaired and refinement writes suppressed, file bytes unchanged), 16 (a third process continued the stored baseline — document ratio 3.3333 with baseline.capturedAt equal to the first process's instant and percentages still 10/40; a re-anchor would have produced baseline 60/55 and no ratio), 17/18 (a DeepSeek entry's /budget clear over the same root archived the whole document, opened a new non-holiday period, and left codex-usage-estimate.json byte-identical).

criteria.criterion: AC4 — the real host proves the authentication / endpoint / settlement-trigger wiring
criteria.evidence: bun scripts/pi-model-cost-smoke.ts, pi 1.2.0 real RPC runs: recorded calls are exactly GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage with timeoutMs 10000 and proxy "codex", carrying Authorization: Bearer <the token the run declared> and chatgpt-account-id from that token's claim; one query at initialization and exactly one more per settled Codex Turn while the 1 ms TTL is stale (with call timestamps 55 ms apart), none when the reading is fresh under a 10-minute TTL, and two when the first attempt failed (a failure earns no TTL).
